item.title: Top Accelerators for Entrepreneurs Who Want to Focus on Validation in Chennai
item.description: Chennai has quietly built a strong startup support ecosystem—but not all accelerators are created equal, especially if your primary goal is real market validation rather than pitch decks and demo days.
